decision: Ratify the revised entry segment (mid-size national and single-issue sponsors of about 5,000-50,000 funds and advisor-distributed sponsors on admin fees, subject to the CNV-ECO-003 evidence gate) and the deferral of workplace and administrator models.

decided_by: Product owner (packet P-LEG review: 'we don't pick the investment funds and pass all of fund management off to someone like Schwab')
decision: Neither Unbound nor the sponsor selects or manages investments and no sponsor-maintained investment pools are offered. Each sponsor delegates investment management of fund assets to an external registered investment manager or custodian platform (for example Schwab) under a written agreement. The sponsor board keeps the non-delegable duties to select the manager, set the scope and investment policy, and monitor performance and cost. Donors may recommend allocations only among options the manager makes available; Unbound relays those recommendations and ingests positions, transactions, units and valuations, and reconciles them.

decided_by: Product owner (explicit confirmation 2026-11-24: 'Record as stated')
decision: Product strategy: one small, nimble core with two offers against the same incumbent: (1) DAF software licensed to sponsors and administrators, competing with Ren's iPhi platform; (2) an Unbound-operated administration team, competing with Ren's outsourced administration. Amends SPD-ADV-004 from 'software platform only' to 'software first, staffed administration as a planned second offer'. SPD-ADV-001 unchanged: Unbound staff may prepare and process; each sponsor's own appointed people make reserved decisions. Supersedes the OD-M-04 reopening trigger.

decided_by: Product owner (explicit ratification of packet P-PLT: 'Ratify with K+L+M')

decided_by: Product owner ('assume complex assets are a rarity ... sold when they are donated and turned into cash')
decision: Complex (non-publicly-traded) assets are expected to be rare. They are accepted only through a contracted intermediary that sells them on receipt, so the fund is credited with cash proceeds; Unbound and the sponsor handle intake checks, the donor acknowledgment (described without value) and reconciliation of proceeds, not holding or valuation of the asset.

decided_by: Product owner (on the pricing gate: 'yes but not validated by client. We set what the market will bare')
decision: Licence prices are set by the Unbound board at what the market will bear, informed by the public-data replay and observed incumbent prices. No sponsor or client validation and no 12-month price review is required, and a price list is not gated on a real-sponsor replay or time study. Customer cost-saving claims and segment commitments remain gated on CNV-ECO-003 measurement (not addressed by this decision).

decided_by: Product owner ('Do the savings claim')
decision: Customer cost-saving claims may be made before a real-sponsor replay, on modelled or public-data evidence, provided each claim states its basis and comparator, gives P50 with the P10–P90 range or a conservative bound, carries a 'modelled estimate' disclosure where modelled, is limited to enterprise types where the model shows the saving, is entered in the approved-claims register and approved by the Unbound board, and is withdrawn or restated within 30 days if later measurement contradicts it. Segment commitments remain gated. Draft claims CLM-01..05 in report 15 await board approval.

decided_by: Product owner acting as Unbound board ('Approve please')
decision: Approve savings claims CLM-02, CLM-03, CLM-04 and CLM-05 as written in report 15, and CLM-01 as a template to be completed with the board-approved price. Publication remains subject to the disclosure and 30-day withdrawal rules in CNV-ECO-003; counsel review of the wording is recommended before publication.

decided_by: Product owner ('We won't get a sponsor at this point'; chose 'First customer + internal study' and 'build it now')
decision: No design-partner sponsor will be available. The first paying sponsor's contract carries the report-12 evidence obligations (12-month shadow replay and 90-day time study at that sponsor), whose measurements restate the modelled savings claims; they are not a condition of price (OD-M-11 stands). Before then, an internal time study of Unbound's own team working a synthetic operating year generated from public data and the model's parameters (report 16) is the handling-time evidence. Segment commitments become a board decision on reports 14 and 16.
